AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.

4. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

9. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

10. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

13. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
